properties.site-address: Land at Bushey Hall Golf Club, Bushey
properties.notes: Alt.ref: SADM - H4. 16/1579/FUL GRANTED. Application online: https://www6.hertsmere.gov.uk/online-applications/simpleSearchResults.do?action=firstPage. Demolition of existing Clubhouse, former print works, ProShop and maintenance buildings. Erection of a new single storey Golf Clubhouse with associated basement facilities and retention of the existing golf club car park, accessed off Bushey Hall Drive. Erection of a part two, part 3 storey with roof level accommodation residential building comprising 31 self-contained residential units (6 x 1 bed, 19 x 2 bed and 6 x 3 bed) with underground car parking, relocated access off Bushey Hall Drive, with associated refuse and cycle stores, landscaping and communal and private amenity space. (Amended plans received 02/11/16)
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
